title: Elderflower Nabemono
description: A quick-fix Japanese plant-based-friendly nabemono featuring elderflower for a resinous and crisp flavor. Serve with rice or noodles.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the soba noodles according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and set them aside.
In a separate large pot, combine the lotus root, mushrooms, and 2 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the elderflower, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Cook the ginger in the microwave for 30 seconds to soften it.
Slice the ginger into thin rounds and add it to the pot.
Simmer the nabemono for 2 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the nabemono hot, garnished with additional elderflower if desired.
Serve with cooked soba noodles or rice noodles on the side.
